subject: Studio session scheduling + prework checklist for POC lab
messages:
From: Tara Jenkins <tara.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Hands-on studio session & POC scheduling

Hi Soojin / Diego,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team (Eli and I) are excited to move to a short POC. We’d like a 3-hour hands-on studio session where our ML engineers and SREs can:
- walk through prompt variants and expected routing behavior
- run a small load test (spike + steady) against the proposed config
- validate KV/prefix caching for our user flows

Proposed window: any afternoon next week (Apr 6-8), 1:00–4:00 PT. Can you confirm availability and what prework we should circulate to participants?

Also: can you share a rough attendee list cap and any firewall/IP allowlist requirements we need to raise with our infra team?

Thanks,
Tara Jenkins
Director, AI Platform
Acme Corp
[tara.jenkins@acmecorp.com]

---
Attachment: acme-internal-roles.csv (CSV, referenced for attendee roles)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Jenkins <tara.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on studio session & POC scheduling

Hi Tara — great to hear. Diego and I are available for the afternoons you listed. Quick answers up front:
- We recommend a 2.5–3 hour block to include a 30-minute load test and wrap-up.
- Attendee cap: 8 active seats (recommendation: 4 engineers + 2 SRE/infra + 1 PM + 1 exec observer).
- IP allowlist: we’ll need outbound access to our dedicated test endpoints; Diego, can you add the ephemeral IPs?

I’ll propose specific calendar slots below. If those work, Ben (solutions eng) will assemble a pre-read pack (agenda, prompt runbook, and a short load test plan).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 6, 1:00–4:00
- Wed Apr 7, 1:30–4:30
- Thu Apr 8, 2:00–5:00

If you prefer tighter timing, we can compress to 2 hours by trimming the load test. Also: please confirm whether you want us to run the load test from our hosted staging vs your VPC — both possible, different allowlist steps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Cc: Tara Jenkins <tara.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on studio session & POC scheduling

Thanks Soojin — Wed Apr 7, 1:30–4:30 PT works best for us.

Couple of clarifying Qs before you finalize the agenda:
1) For the prompt review, can you include an example prompt set (system + user + few-shot) that demonstrates routing to a cheaper variant when latency allows?
2) For load tests, we’ll prefer Redwood-hosted staging so we don’t have to provision firewall changes this week. Will that change the steps you send?

We’ll plan for 6 active participants on our side (3 ML, 2 SRE, 1 PM). I’ll share attendee names by EOD tomorrow.

- Eli
Eli Navarro
Staff ML Engineer, Acme Corp
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Jenkins <tara.jenkins@acmecorp.com>, Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@acmecorp.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700

Thanks all — Wed Apr 7, 1:30–4:30 PT is confirmed on our side. Sharing the initial prework bundle below. Please review and flag any gaps.

Prework bundle (attached & links):
- Redwood_POC_Studio_Agenda_v1.pdf (attached) — detailed minute-by-minute plan, owners for each segment
- prompt-runbook.md (attached) — example system/user templates and routing knobs (cheap/fast fallback patterns)
- loadtest-plan.xlsx (attached) — steady-state and spike scenarios; test harness will run from Redwood staging unless you confirm VPC run
- short checklist (inline):
  * Provide final attendee list (names + emails + role) by Tue Apr 6, 12:00 PT
  * Confirm whether you want us to run load tests from Redwood staging (default: yes)
  * Share any data sensitivity notes (no PII in test prompts unless redaction agreed)

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Studio_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB); prompt-runbook.md (Markdown, 18KB); loadtest-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

We’ll also include a short Zoom calendar invite (coming from calendar@redwood.ai) and a Drive folder for collaborative notes. If you want a dry run for your SREs before Wed, we can do a 30-minute preflight on Tue Apr 6 at 4:00 PT.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
